long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Rome into the third generation of the Bulgari jewellery family, Paolo Bulgari began working with his father while still young. His training ranged from raw-material purchasing and bench work to design, his great passion. He also developed recognised expertise in precious stones. That hands-on formation linked commercial leadership to the colour and craftsmanship of Bulgari's creative identity.

Bulgari became chairman in 1984 and led the house alongside other family executives as it expanded internationally. He directed its creative work for many years, remaining chairman after the company joined LVMH. He later served on the luxury group's advisory board. In 2019, he and his wife established the Paolo Bulgari Foundation to support education and neighbourhood regeneration in Rome.
